required_documents.name: Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Submitted in Grants.gov as Step 1 of the two-step application process.

required_documents.name: Proposal Questionnaire
required_documents.details: Completed online in JustGrants covering Statement of the Problem, Project Design, and Capabilities.

required_documents.name: Budget Detail Worksheet
required_documents.details: Web-based form in JustGrants itemizing all direct project costs with narrative computation.

required_documents.name: Project Timeline
required_documents.details: Upload listing key activities, milestones, and expected completion months.

eligibility.summary: Eligible applicants as specified under Grants.gov opportunity O-OJJDP-2026-172735. Qualifying North Carolina jurisdictions and organizations may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity O-OJJDP-2026-172735.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
